summary: The one-liner makes 'documented' call modify_field_list, which fixes the visible missing-return-type symptom but also makes 'documented' add :type:/:param: entries for UNDOCUMENTED parameters — collapsing the semantic distinction between 'documented' and 'all'. A maintainer aware of the config semantics would not merge as-is.

issues.description: 'documented' target semantic is 'only add type info for already-documented params/returns'. modify_field_list adds :type: and :param: fields for every annotation, including undocumented parameters, so this patch makes 'documented' behave identically to 'all' for param types. Reproduction case (all params documented) hides this because every field is documented, but users with partially-documented signatures now get types injected for undocumented params — a regression of the intended 'documented' behavior.

Wrong abstraction: correct fix should preserve documented-only param handling while still emitting the return type (e.g. augment path with rtype support / a suppress_rtype flag), not route 'documented' through the 'all' code path. Reusing modify_field_list is a shortcut that conflates two distinct config values.
